sourceReferences.title: RFC 5626 - Managing Client-Initiated Connections in SIP
sourceReferences.use: Direct behavioral source for Require: outbound, CRLF keepalive, flow failure/replacement, and AOR/+sip.instance/reg-id binding semantics; retained as a source reference rather than inventing a matrix authority id.

objective: Prove one controlled outbound flow, CRLF keepalive response, detected connection loss, replacement registration with the same AOR/+sip.instance/reg-id binding key, and inbound request delivery over the replacement TLS flow.
negativeControls: registration success without Require: outbound is insufficient
replacement registration with a changed instance-id or reg-id fails
replacement registration without an inbound request traversing the replacement flow is insufficient
recovery backoff timing is not exercised; immediate replacement is deterministic harness acceleration
outbound-flow proof does not establish media or accessibility readiness
requiredBeforeProven: portable external/local runner produces the declared evidence bundle
first flow receives Require: outbound after authenticated registration
CRLF ping and pong are observed on the registered connection
client detects the controlled first-flow failure
replacement registration preserves the AOR/+sip.instance/reg-id binding key
an inbound SIP request and correlated response traverse the replacement flow
